Text: It's over! Lay down your arms, and I promise you won't come to further harm!
Godsdammit... If it wasn't for that sage...
Ungh... Well, well...
So, shall we practice some somanoutical fundamentals?
Some manner of plant seems to have been harvested here. I can't identify it by the remaining parts, however...
There may be other clues nearby. We should investigate further.
Th-Their enhancement has given them such power!?
ロイファを狙いましょう！
Mahaud, return the favor and take care of that sage! Finish it!
Grrr, damn you!
Defeat the chimera.
Speak with Drusilla.
Gibbet will hurt 'em from the flank, and Gallows will surprise 'em from behind. If you're getting' swarmed, use Guillotine to carve yourself some space.
The chimera won't be able to resist the smell of blood─make sure to soak these sands in it!
You're getting' the hang of it! Gibbet will hurt 'em from the side─switch off between that and Gallows to make your attacks even more deadly!
That's what I like to see! Gallows will hurt 'em from behind─switch off between that and Gibbet to make your attacks even more deadly!
You're usin' Guillotine like a true killer! Reap a feast of souls in one fell swoop!
You've takin' to killin' more quickly than I could've hoped. It'll be an easy thing to summon your avatar to your side.
Let's move on to the fun bit, eh? Your avatar will help you strike fear into the hearts of your foes.
Now call it to your side! Blood stalk and grim swathe will make short work of these fiends!
The bloodshed should've gotten the chimera's attention. Steel yourself for a fight!
Our target arrives. Finish this and I'll let you keep its head as a trophy!
So long as your avatar is by your side, monsters like this are nothin' more than easy prey.
Show me you've been listenin', <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! Give your avatar a feast to remember!
Remember to position yourself! Gibbet from the side, Gallows from the rear! Simple enough, eh?
Fill your Soul Gauge and summon your avatar!
Defeat the mired chimera!
Harvest the souls of the fallen to summon your avatar!
Use Gibbet
Use Gallows
Use Guillotine
Hehehe! I have awaited this feast for far too long. I think I shall skip straight to the main course!
The pig squirms and writhes. Stay still and let the chef's blade finish the job!
Hmph. Very well. Meat is all the more delicious when it is tenderized!
Give him a taste of his own vile medicine, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>. Rip his soul out!
You just worry about Orcus, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>. I'll take care of the rest.
Gah... No...
Defeat Orcus!
Ugh... I can't die...without a final meal.
Lightning gathers! We must head it off!
To attack with such reckless abandon... Their bodies and minds must be on the verge of breaking!
Sharlayan will suffer your villainy no more!
Damn it, they're not in their right minds!
You'll pay for all the lives you've destroyed!
Spread out, spread out!
Stay with me, my friends! We'll free you yet!
Wake up, Ancel! Please!
Steady, Mahaud! Steady!
みんな、当たらないように散るんだ！
Ancel! <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)> needs our help!
Aaahhh! Arrrggghhh!
Unnnghhh... Arrrggghhh!
Heh heh heh... Let us begin with you, Ancel!
That will do, that will do... Mahaud─your turn!
Man's frail flesh is his greatest flaw! If we are to evolve, we must break free of its confines!
Hm, so this is your limit. \\<sigh> Yet another disappointment...but perhaps you can take one of these meddlers with you to the grave!
Ahahahahahaha!
You truly are fascinating specimens! Oh, the things I will learn from your cadavers!
This proving ground was prepared especially for you. I trust you won't mind if I harvest a sample or two!
Come, let us test the edge of my scalpel!
I am quite experienced in the art of amputation. You won't feel a thing!
Subdue Ancel and Mahaud.
Defeat Guildivain!
You're disgusting!
This bodes ill... We must finish him quickly!
Then we have no choice but to subdue them.
People are not your playthings, you fiend!
Hmph, laugh while you can! You won't be doing it much longer!
It has been a tremendous pleasure, my dear subjects. But all good things must come to an end.
Oh gods, not this spell!
Damn it, he's taken control of their minds again!
Oho, it seems our two sages have protection─intrinsic and extrinsic, respectively. Curiouser and curiouser...
Not good... At this rate, their minds will be irreparably damaged!
This magick is derived from somanoutics! If we destroy his nouliths, we can break its hold!
Too clever by half! But you'll need to be quick too, else your comrades' brains will melt in their skulls.
Yes, we did it! Are you all right, my friends!?
\\<pant> \\<pant> I think so... Thank you...

Your successor is proving <If(PlayerParameter(4))>herself<Else/>himself</If> quite the nuisance, Hatia... But unique as <If(PlayerParameter(4))>she<Else/>he</If> is, <If(PlayerParameter(4))>she<Else/>he</If> is most definitely worth the trouble!
Keep your comrades alive and break their mind control.
Defeat Erichthonios
I must save them... But first...
You will go no further...
I'll shatter you against the stones!
Be assailed by ice and flame!
Your bones to ash! Your flesh to ice!
You leave me no choice...
I cannot allow you to run free!
Chains to bind you!
No... The lives of my colleagues are at stake!
Should it cost me my life, I will triumph!
I must... I must return you to your cell!
These shackles cannot be sundered!
Cast off my chains, and I shall bind you again! Ever tighter...
This shall be your final resting place!
Be imprisoned 'twixt light and flame!
Run all you like, but my chains will catch you!
Drag them unto the depths, O chains!
I will lock you away, once and again! Forever!
Defeat the phoinix

理由はわからないが、獄卒長が環境を作り変えたみたいだ……！
ともかく今は眼前の脅威を、フェネクスを弱らせてくれ！
Minato holds me responsible for Kisei's death. I will keep its attention.
Have care. The air is thick with her malice.
It means to charge! <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, can you break its focus?
Well struck.
Remain calm and alert. It may attempt another charge.
A formidable foe indeed. But we will not be bested!
It readies to strike! On your guard!
I...I can't move...
We must discuss your change of vocation─after dealing with the blasphemy.
Quickly! We must protect Gosetsu!
You have my thanks.
Urgh... This is nothing.
It comes for me! Perhaps a grazing shot will break its concentration.
Expertly done!
I am not so easily broken.
I sense something amiss. Quickly, to me!
A test of my will and training both. Hold fast, everyone!
Well done, Gosetsu. Now, I believe it is past time we put Minato's soul to rest.
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! Are you all right?
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! Hold on!
Defeat Izanami
Prove your strength to Venat!
Let neither side hold back.
Impressive... I shall have to try something different.
I see you won't be easily overcome...but neither will I.
We've only just begun. Come at me with your all!
My blade sings!
There!
Have a taste!
No quarter!
Prepare yourself!
Very well, let us move to the final trial.
Break your chains, shed your burdens─and show me your strength of will!
You still stand. The people of your time are more resilient than I had dared hope.
I have seen enough.
Defeat Hesperos
I have awaited this moment... Witness the full measure of a hemitheos's power!
There is but one master in Asphodelos!
These halls are my domain!
If you insist upon this folly, then you must face the full extent of my authority!
I shall feast upon your aether!
Your aether turns...and by it shall you be undone!
A rat in a maze is amusing at first, but it is still a rat─vermin to be disposed of.
Scurry, vermin, ere my blade finds your bellies...
This chlamys is no mere affectation, I assure you!
For trespass in my domain shall you be judged!
Do not believe victory yours... I can yet shed this meager form and usher you back to the star!
To him do I dedicate this transformation─this victory!
Power courses through me! And you... You will feed my subjects!
A tragedy unfolds within the halls of Asphodelos. Rejoice, for you are its star!
And the final act begins! Bring your adoring fans to tears!
To those who endured every tragic turn, stand at attention for the curtain call!
A tragedy demands death. Discard your delusions of salvation and embrace catharsis!
'Tis said that there are no ifs in history, yet man is wont to dream. Let us dream, then, of a future where a dear comrade lived...
Your feeble light shall fade before my brilliance!
Undone by mortal will. Whither now...?
O Ascalon! Drink deep of the power of slumbering gods!
Y-You survived my divine reckoning!? Impossible!
This is the power of Light? No... If I must fall, then so shall you!
Thy final verse is sung!

Thou hast survived my song...
Curse thee and thine eye, Hraesvelgr!
Wriggling maggots! I shall grind you to paste in my jaws!
I swore to Shiva─swore that I would not take the lives of men... Stop me, I prithee!
I thank thee, servant of Hydaelyn... Now I may go to be with my beloved...
Thus did one song draw to a close. But here and now, this minstrel shall perform another─a song of imagination transcending...
At long last, this flesh belongeth to me! And now, wicked mortals─my dirge shall usher you unto your doom!
Hahahaha! By the power of mine enemy's eyes, I am become a god eternal!
O Ascalon! Purge the tainted with the light of sorrow immeasurable!
O Ascalon! Consign the wicked with the light of rancor unquenchable!
O Ascalon! Scorch the earth with the light of regret unfathomable!
Your time is come! Eyes of mine enemy, bring oblivion unto the unbelievers!
Dragonsong War Progress
Alternate Dragonsong War Progress

In pursuit of the archbishop, the Warrior of Light journeyed to Azys Lla, where <If(PlayerParameter(4))>she<Else/>he</If> confronted a primal born of the power of the Eye: King Thordan and his knights twelve.

Though <If(PlayerParameter(4))>she<Else/>he</If> emerged victorious, <If(PlayerParameter(4))>her<Else/>his</If> comrade's body was claimed by Nidhogg, who brought his unbridled rage to bear against Ishgard.
A single life can alter the course of history... Enslaved by an ancient relic, the great wyrm Hraesvelgr descended upon Ishgard at his vengeful brother's side.
Thus did a dreadful new divinity arise─one endowed with the nigh-irrepressible life force of two great wyrms...
Tell me, Warrior of Light. How do you propose to end this conflict?
If you believe that eliminating me will undo a thousand years of strife and suffering, then you are a fool.
It should go without saying, but stay on your guard. There was quite the menagerie of horrors when last I was here.
They're upon us! To arms!
Merlwyb and I shall hold them off. Press on, my friends!
A persistent lot, aren't they?
I shall hold the line here. When you see an opening, take it, and do not look back!
Nerva never did make things easy. Let's get this over with.
More are coming! Stay sharp!
There is no end to them...
Careful there, Leveilleur. They have their sights set on you.
I will see to the rabble. You focus on the large one there.
Very well. With me, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
This ends here, Nerva. For Garlemald, her people, and all who call this star home!
Blasphemy or no, I'll not suffer anyone who gets in my way!
For glory...everlasting. For Garlemald!
Hold on, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>!
We must take the offensive!
To me... My legion!
We will be overrun at this rate...
Bring them here, and leave the rest to me.
Dammit, how could that have missed!? No matter, we will deal with them easily enough.
Behind me, quickly! I shall take the brunt of it!
We must...drive it back!
\\<pant> \\<pant> Gods be good...
We've come too far...to give up now...
Then let's put an end to this, shall we?
No! Garlemald...is mine! MINE!!!
No, <split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>! Are you all right?
Get a hold of yourself, <If(PlayerParameter(4))>woman<Else/>man</If>! We've a monster to slay!
Reach the top of the Tower of Babil!
Defeat Nerva's minions!
Defeat Nerva yae Galvus!

Clear the undersea entrance

Unrecognized aetherial signature...
Brazen thief! You will proceed no further!
Turn back, treasure seeker, or this vault will be your tomb.
Your greed will prove your undoing...

Warning. This vault is under my protection.
Failure to withdraw will invite chastisement.

Spin and fumble!
Stumble and fall!

Leave now, and live.
This is your final warning.

Willful trespass confirmed.
You have chosen...death.
All intruders will be slain!

Glyph of passage detected.
Confirming bearer's identity...
I have taken the liberty of preparing an electrifying stage for you.
Meet one of my creations. You might find it a handful.
I will lay Garlond low, but first I must break you!
\\<pant> I will not suffer...to be in another's shadow!
Let us dance, champion of Eorzea.
Impressive! Now it is my turn!
Know your place!
Come, we shall see if you can finish what you have started.
Eorzea is mine by right!
That you should still stand... Very well, then!

Right, I'll examine the equipment for intelligence. Press on─I'll let you know if I learn anything.
Well, well, would you look at this! It's the armor we borrowed for our mission at Castrum Centri!
If this isn't fate, I don't know what is! Go on, strap yourself in and raise hells!
If you will not yield, then you will be destroyed!
We need to make our way down. There ought to be a terminal for the lift up ahead.
Here it is. If you'd care to take the van, I'll follow after I've had a look around.

Clear the Path

Clear the Twin Halls
The Builder has been made to yield...
Intriguing. Then the Destroyer shall take your measure...
...After you have provided my servant with some sport.
In the name of the Destroyer, I will lay you low.
My divine axe will rend you in twain!
Come, show me the strength of mankind!
Upon the ground you shall crawl!
By my authority as the Destroyer...
I will break you body and soul!
Wandering star, descend and destroy!
Keep a reverent distance!
Bask in my blinding resplendence!
Can you predict your own undoing?
Most impressive, children of man...
A domain aspected to lightning... Byregot is here, I shouldn't doubt.
The mechanical spire ahead could have been plucked straight out of legend!
That you should best a divinity... I couldn't have asked for better help!
So the gods have minions at their beck and call... We must proceed with care.
Rhalgr isn't known as the god of destruction without reason. Steel yourself.
Ahead stands a statue I have fashioned for our contest.
Come, mortals. Enter my realm─if you dare.
Another domain─one aspected to fire...
Then the voice that called out to us...
Mere minions are no match for you, 'twould seem.
A divinity awaits us beyond. Have care.
Look how the sky has changed! The result of your victory over Azeyma, I daresay...
There's a city up ahead... Could there be people here?
Prepare to be judged, children of man.
Ashes you will be.
Will you weather my trial?
We have only just begun!
The flames of the abyss consume all.
Bitterest suffering awaits.
From ashes you came, to ashes you will return.
Still you defy our divine authority.
Very well. Let us proceed to your judgment.
We, the Traders, shall weigh your souls!
Preserve the balance if you can.
5 seconds to Balance.
4 seconds to Balance.
3 seconds...
2 seconds...
1 second...
Once more─and once more only─we shall weigh your souls.
Preserve the balance.
The moment of judgment is come.
You have been found wanting.
You shall wander in purgatory for eternity.
You have passed our judgment...
Well done! You are deserving of reward!
Man's tenacity is a sight to behold!
As a show of esteem, we shall bring our all to bear.
Hahaha! Such vim and vigor!
So this is the spirit of man...
You shall bear witness to our might...
But will you be able to comprehend it?

That mortals should set foot in our divine realm...
Come, we shall see whether you are fit to remain!
So, you are resolved to face me.
By my power shall a new world be forged.
Come, children of man!
Scatter!
Tremble before my divinity!
Behold the virtuosity of the Builder!
Behold the works of a god!
To me, O hammer divine!
Searing light, smite my foes!
The thunder is mine to command!
If you would halt our ascension, then press on...
Witness the glory of the divine!
Bend the knee!
'Tis too late to beg mercy!
You will be scoured by the light of the Sun!
O crimson fan, in fire woven...
In your wake leave naught uncleansed!
Is it just a mirage...or something more?
Hahaha! I've quite warmed to you!
An explosive finish!
Let there be fire!
Raging flames, dance upon the wind!
None can escape the inferno!
This will burn!
A gift of flame for our children!
Ever shall the fires burn...
Every soul in this domain ssserves me now.<<key>>Come, feassst upon their flesh!
さぁ、餌の時間だ…！
The castle answers his call...<<key>>We'd do well to break up this feast quickly.
戦闘が長引くとまずそうね……。
Then let's see these guests on their way.
Behold the power of the archfiend of earth!
He hastens their regeneration!
We are deathlessssss.<<key>>You cannot defeat that which cannot die!
ゆえに、貴様らに勝ち目はない！
Struggle and slaughter all you like!
Our foe has too great an advantage...
We need to drag him out of this damnable feast.
There's no end in sight...<<key>>A retreat may be in order.
一度退いて、策を練った方がよさそうね。
However incurred, a debt is a debt.<<key>>I will repay it here and now.
この戦いに加勢することで、チャラにしてもらうぞ。
What is this power?
You will tremble before my true ssstrength!
Know your end is nigh!
Attend to the minions first.
Finally getting serious, are we?<<key>>Very well, let us return the favor!
ならば、こっちも全力でいくぞ！
Trickery will not save you!
Enough! Enough!
We cannot win without Zero. We must help her!
Hmph. If I must deal with you first...<>I'll kill you all myself!
Pathetic! Useless!
I'll kill you all myself!
This place will be your grave!
This magick... We must stop him now!
Defeat all enemies.
Defeat Scarmiglione!
She can turn voidsent into crystal...
The Ultima Weapon has partaken of the power of eikons! None can stand against it!
Yield to the storm!
The wind is at my beck and call!
Naught can pierce the raging tempest!
Thy foe is Darkness clad in steel. If thou wouldst triumph, thou must look to the Light.
Titan's essence...torn from the Ultima Weapon!?
No matter─it still harbors the might of other eikons!
Kneel to the might below!
The land itself is mine to wield!
Be entombed in earth!
Once more, crystal bearer. Look to the Light to vanquish the Darkness.
Garuda's as well!? Impossible!
But the Ultima Weapon is not spent of eikon power yet!
Succumb to the flames!
So this is the strength of the eikon-slayer...
Very well, let us see how you fare when the Ultima Weapon's power inhibitor is disengaged!
Naught will remain of you but ash!
Yield not to the Darkness, my child. Pray to the Crystal with all thy being.
No! How...how are you doing this!?
We settle this once and for all!
I need not the power of eikons to defeat you! Gaze upon true power!
This is most...unexpected. You are possessed of great might, this I will allow.
Yet yours is not the might of a ruler! Such is the difference between us─a difference that will assure my victory!
U-Ultima!? Curse you, Ascian!
How much destruction must be wreaked before you are sated!?
I have not the strength...to shield thee again...
Permit not the manifestation of that vile magick...lest Darkness prevail!
Ultima detonation in 20 seconds.
Ultima detonation in 10 seconds.
Ultima detonation in 5 seconds.
Your time is at an end, Hydaelyn!
Hear... Feel... Think...

I will suffer none to oppose Lord van Baelsar!
Like countless other challengers, you will fall before me!
My shields are impregnable!
Your defeat will bring Lord van Baelsar's noble conquest one step closer to fruition!
Ugh... So this is the strength of <If(PlayerParameter(4))>she<Else/>he</If> who vanquished Titan...
Let us aid you, my lord!
What? I thought I ordered you to leave!
Forgive us, my lord, but we couldn't let you face the enemy alone!
Your conviction and courage will not be for naught! This I swear!
For victory and vengeance, I will strike you down!
Hah, I have you now!
We shall go together, amidst a raging inferno!
No amount of pain can loosen my grip!
Ungh... You will not escape...
Rest in peace, men... I shall join you soon...
\\<pant> \\<pant> It's over... Strong as you are, you cannot survive this!

Let me show you a technique passed down in my homeland!
You do not hold back! Very well, neither shall I!
Ignore pain... Ignite rage... And fight with the fury of wildfire!
You will have no mercy from me!
We've raised the alarm as you bade...and now we would fight with you!

This is Cid. To review, our goal is to deactivate the magitek field.
If you could create a diversion─that's to say, wreak lots of havoc─I'll search for the field generator.
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, how are you faring? ...Reached a dead end, you say? I believe I know where you are.
There's a disposal chute nearby. Find it and jump in, and you'll emerge in a different sector.
<split(<String>ObjectParameter(1)</String>, ,1)>, assault crafts are near! Watch out for incoming fire!
I've located the controls for the security system. A moment while I disable the barriers.
Another bulkhead, eh? Fortunately I'm equipped for the task. Stand back!
Come on, the field generator should be just up ahead!
There it is! Keep the enemy occupied while I take it out of commission!
You will not take any more from me!
The pain I have suffered, I shall visit upon you a hundredfold!
You have made me wroth!
Hmph, you're tough, I grant you that.
But I will break you soon enough!
You will not defeat me! You will not!
I'm also pleased to say I've found a suit of armor. Press on─I'll meet you just ahead.
Damn, reinforcements! Take care of them, would you?
We must hold the enemy here! All units─attack!
The central crossing is overrun! Requesting immediate reinforcements!
Gah, damn these savages! Deploy the reserve colossi!
How can this be...? R-Reinforcements! We need more reinforcements!
We have seen the end.
The same end, again and again.
All of us have known despair.
A sorrow so deep only emptiness remains.
'Tis so lonely between the stars.
As surely as stars fall from the heavens, all civilizations are destined to die.
This is fate!
All light is destined to fade─all happiness give way to suffering.
Embrace the quiet!
Utterly futile.
Your suffering is at an end.
Ahhh, it comes flooding back. The memory of a star ravaged by disease.
Quick as a shadow, doom comes to claim us.
Ever shall we sing, our voice resounding throughout the vast expanse.
Unto you we shall deliver the answer of all the lives that came before.
No life, no star, nor the universe itself...
None should hope for better!
We cannot suffer it again...
